name.ja: BB戦士274 少年法師霧丸

description.ja: コミックボンボンにてマンガ好評連載中の「SD ガンダムフォース絵巻 武者列伝 武化舞可編」に登場する「少年法師霧丸」のBB戦士でのプラモデル。低年齢でも組み立てやすい少ないパーツで構成しています。フィンファンネル羽うちわと錫杖を装備可能です。首、腕、足の付け根が可動します。親武者である龍神導師仁宇に武化舞可の天翼を装着可能です。龍神導師仁宇に付属のカブト、肩鎧、フィンファンネルを装着可能です。
description.en: A BB Senshi plastic model of "Shoboshi Kirimaru " that appears in " SD Gundam Force Emaki Musha Retsuden Busaka Maika Hen" which is currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon. It is composed of a small number of parts that are easy to assemble even at a young age. Can be equipped with a fin funnel feather fan and a tin cane. The neck, arms, and base of the legs are movable. It is possible to attach the Heavenly Wings of Busaka Maika to the pro-Musha Ryujin Doushi Niu. The helmet, shoulder armor, and fin funnels that come with Dragon God Master Niu can be attached.
